responsibility: Implements SSA name coalescing for out-of-SSA translation and live-range based partition merging. It builds preferred coalesce pairs from copies and PHIs, computes live ranges and conflict graphs, ranks coalescing opportunities by cost and conflicts, handles abnormal-edge constraints, and merges compatible partitions in var_map so later out-of-SSA lowering can minimize inserted copies while respecting liveness and type/alignment compatibility.
same_name_distinction: This file contains the full SSA coalescing implementation: building coalesce candidates, computing costs and conflicts from liveness, sorting pairs, and merging partitions for out-of-SSA. The companion gcc/tree-ssa-coalesce.h only exposes the small public entry points used to invoke or query coalescing.
